title: TS run-state store throws on a classify-tick decision record the Go reconciler writes
body: Epic wne added RoleClassifyTick to runstate.DecisionRoles() in Go, but cloudflare/src/run-state-store.ts validateDecision still checks role against ROLES only. decision() throws 'unreadable decision', decisions() goes through decision() and throws too, and epic-reconciler.ts calls decisions() at lines 627 and 1041. A run branch carrying a classification therefore breaks every decisions() read on the Workflow host. It is latent until a classifier is wired, and it is a Go/TS parity break in stores documented as mirrors.
